title: Invertibility, Often
summary: By using a similar pattern of arguments, we show that in four categories the collection of isomorphisms forms a residual subset of the space of morphisms. We first consider surjective continuous mappings on Cantor spaces. Next, we look at measure preserving maps on Polish measure spaces. We then consider the $L^1$ representations of nonsingular maps on Polish measure spaces. Finally, we examine continuous, measure preserving maps on Cantor spaces equipped with so-called good measures.
